stderr:
Unknown command: stdio

Ledger MCP (cork-ledger-mcp)

  npx -y cork-ledger-mcp@latest                     start the MCP server (Claude starts it; set LEDGER_ENV=prod or dev)
  npx -y cork-ledger-mcp@latest login --prod        sign in, in Terminal: email, password, then the Authenticator code
  npx -y cork-ledger-mcp@latest logout --prod       revoke this machine's key and sign out
  npx -y cork-ledger-mcp@latest pair --prod --mac <name> [--stdout]
                                      make this machine's sign-in key (a year), or with --stdout print one for another machine

Options: login [--email x], --dev in place of --prod for the dev deployment.
Sign-in files: ~/.config/ledger/ (LEDGER_MCP_HOME moves it). File folders: LEDGER_FOLDERS, paths separated by ":".
